patch.summary: Close migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Close by inventorying legacy crm fields, mapping them to Close objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating WhatsApp Business, Slack before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Growth (list price annual) and Scale (list price annual) per-user pricing is high versus pipeline-only CRMs; calling usage and premium phone lines add cost.
Success signal: contact management works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Close migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power contact management, lead management, pipeline management and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Close; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate WhatsApp Business; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Inside sales and outbound teams that live on phone/email/SMS outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Growth (list price annual) and Scale (list price annual) per-user pricing is high versus pipeline-only CRMs; calling usage and premium phone lines add cost.
If Close mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Pipedrive before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire WhatsApp Business in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Growth (list price annual) and Scale (list price annual) per-user pricing is high versus pipeline-only CRMs; calling usage and premium phone lines add cost.

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Advanced Chloe automation/workflows and predictive dialing depth are concentrated on Growth and Scale.

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Calling is usage-based; AI credits are pooled monthly with plan caps and no rollover.

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for contact management
Mitigate: Growth (list price annual) and Scale (list price annual) per-user pricing is high versus pipeline-only CRMs; calling usage and premium phone lines add cost.
